title: Agent tools (WebMCP)
description: Lets an AI agent in this browser use IPFS tools on your node through WebMCP. It is off by default. While it is off, this page registers no tool for agents and sends no request on an agent's behalf. Requests go to the node address in the API address setting.

toggle.label: Offer read tools to agents in this browser
toggle.help: Read tools can fetch content from the network through your node. What a tool returns, including file contents, peer addresses and your node's listen addresses, goes to the AI provider behind the agent.

dnslink.label: Let read tools resolve DNSLink names (domains)
dnslink.help: Off, only IPNS names that are libp2p keys resolve. A DNSLink lookup is a DNS request from your node, so injected content could use it to send data out in the name it asks for. Looking up a CID on the network is also visible to the peers that handle the lookup, whatever this setting says.
dnslink.needsFirst: Turn on the read tools first.

writes.label: Also offer tools that change your node
writes.help: Every change asks you first and names the CIDs or paths. This approval is a check against mistakes, not a lock: an agent that controls this browser can click Approve itself. Keep this off while your AI app runs in a browser-control or fully automatic mode. Results of these tools go to the agent's AI provider too. This switch turns itself off whenever the page reloads. Tools that remove or delete are never offered.
writes.needsFirst: Turn on the read tools first; tools that change your node are only offered while they are on.
